Name: Lunna Seasonal Portraits by Chogo
Author: deleted96844928
Description:
Check out my version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7016]Raphael[/url]﻿!

I made an alternate version of Raphael a while ago, so Lunna was the next character! It's seasonal and also has different portraits in each festival.
The special thanks goes to Rafseazz, the creator of the original mod, they helped me out with this one aswell!! 

Just download the file and put it in your Mods folder, it won't overwrite anything.
It requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley [/url]﻿by Rafseazz.

Downloads.Description: Drop it into your Mods files.
